title: Take-up Rate of Trust Services for Persons with Disabilities from Low- and Middle-income Families
what_it_is: Take-up Rate of Trust Services for Persons with Disabilities from Low- and Middle-income Families

sections.label: SNTC trust accounts and schemes
sections.summary: SNTC has 889 trust accounts, mostly from HDB families, and offers schemes helping low-income families with the $5,000 initial capital.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: As of 31 January this year, SNTC has a portfolio of 889 SNTC Trust accounts, of which 65% of the accounts are set up by families living in HDB flats.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: MSF fully funds the operating costs of the SNTC, which helps to ensure that the trust is affordable and accessible to low- and middle-income families.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: The initial capital required to set up an SNTC trust account is only $5,000 compared to private trusts which usually requires at least $50,000.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Since 2011, SNTC has also proactively raised donations under its Financial Assistance Scheme to help eligible low-income elderly caregivers with the initial capital of $5,000 to set up a trust account.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: In October last year, SNTC also launched the Gift of a Lifetime Sponsorship Scheme, or GOAL in short.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: GOAL supports eligible low-income families with the initial $5,000 needed to set up an SNTC trust account and a further $5,000 matching grant to help the parents co-pay the premium of an affordable term policy, where the insurance proceeds will be paid into the child's SNTC trust account upon the demise of the insured parent.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: This better ensures that there will be sufficient funds in the trust account to support the long-term care needs of their child.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: MSF will continue to explore ways to ensure that SNTC trust services remains affordable and accessible to low-income and middle-income families.
